findings.requirement: AC03; work items 2.3/2.4; all potential choices settle before selection
findings.observed: Explicit failureNext becomes TAKEN but SUCCESS stays PENDING. A.success->B, A.failureNext->R, B/R->END FAILURE cannot reach the shared failure end after A fails.
findings.consequence: Failure recovery and selected joins can remain blocked permanently.
findings.minimal_resolution: When explicit failure routing is consumed, settle mutually exclusive success edges and propagate genuinely unselected successors; preserve the original failure, unconsumed technical retry and immutable consumed decisions.
findings.evidence: Static control-flow trace of advance, emit, skip and selection; no runtime reproduction.

findings.requirement: AC02/AC08; work item 3.1; ancestor loop backjump after actual old work is quiescent
findings.observed: The backjump gate requires every TASK/ASK except NOT_SELECTED to be terminal, including a WAITING_SELECTION parent join task whose selected IF child is the backjump source.
findings.consequence: A validated conditional repair loop can never take its first backjump.
findings.minimal_resolution: Check actual selected/started tasks and opened questions, not unresolved future successors; close pending old-round nodes without success while retaining stable exit, carry, history, independent branches and UNKNOWN blocking.
findings.evidence: Static trace of child-return edge, selection and jump guards; validator accepts the described structure.

findings.requirement: Common control; work items 3.3/4.2; global terminal status waits for actual plan work
findings.observed: Recommendations create controlled same-plan tasks outside activation nodes. Cancellation requests their stop but allQuiescent scans only activation taskIds; an empty DRAFT runtime immediately becomes CANCELLED while a planning attempt is RUNNING. Root success can omit the same work.
findings.consequence: Global terminal status can falsely report completion or cancellation before real stop/unknown reconciliation.
findings.minimal_resolution: Use a whole-plan controlled-task/attempt/lease/effect quiescence aggregate for cancellation and root terminal status, including planner and continuation tasks; keep loop-local scope separate.
findings.evidence: Static request/control/tick/Factory call trace, no actual cancellation run.

findings.requirement: Work item 4.3; accepted graph ASK opens a formal question
findings.observed: Ask defaults omitted context/answerRequirements to empty strings; graph validation accepts them. openGraph calls GuardContract.text, which rejects blank, and rolls back tick before recording the question or concrete blocked state.
findings.consequence: A valid public ASK can never yield a question and recovery repeats the exception.
findings.minimal_resolution: Align optional graph projections with formal question construction or return consistent node diagnostics before activation; do not weaken shared authorization text validation.
findings.evidence: Static constructor/validator/openGraph/text comparison, no runtime execution.
